k:松.mnemonic: The tree (木) planted in every public (公) square and along every public road, green right through the winter. Pine tree.
k:松.hint: The evergreen in the town square.

k:歳.mnemonic: A child is measured against a halberd (戈) each birthday: this year he can walk (歩) under the blade, in twelve months he cannot. Years old (age, year-end, occasion).
k:歳.hint: Measured against a halberd each birthday.

k:英.mnemonic: A big (大) man with a wreath of flowers (艹) on his forehead (冖): a hero crowned with roses, the flower of one particular country. England (English, hero, outstanding).

k:権.mnemonic: Whoever can gather (集) every arrow (矢) in the land into his own armoury is the one who gives the orders. Authority (rights, power, strength).
k:権.hint: He who holds all the arrows.

k:充.mnemonic: A cocoon (厶) for each pair of legs (儿): every worker under the lid gets one, shares handed out until the box is full. Allot (fill).
k:充.hint: One cocoon handed to each worker.

k:統.mnemonic: Allot (充) each clan one thread (糸), then twist all the threads into a single rope: many made one. Unify (overall, govern, lineage).
k:統.hint: Clan threads twisted into a rope.

k:双.mnemonic: One hand, and also (又) another hand just like it, with barely a drop (丶) of difference between them: a matching set of two. Pair (set, comparison).

k:殺.mnemonic: A pair (双) of woodcutters, each with a weapon (殳), go at a tree (木) until it is dead and comes crashing down. Kill (slice off, split).

k:建.mnemonic: The architect paces out the site with a long stride (廴), then takes up a brush (聿) and draws the plans. Build.

k:福.mnemonic: At the altar (礻) you pray for one thing: a rice field (田) to feed every mouth (口) at home. When that comes, you are lucky. Blessing (fortune, luck, wealth).
k:福.hint: Praying for a field that feeds all.

k:郎.mnemonic: The most stubborn (艮) boy in the borough (阝): every family has one, and every father sighs, that's my lad. Son (counter for sons).

k:究.mnemonic: Dig into a hole (穴) nine (九) levels deep to find out what lies at the very bottom: follow the question as far as it goes. Research (study, learn, learning).

k:落.mnemonic: After a tsunami (氵) of rain the flowers (艹) shed their petals. You trudge (夂) past with your mouth (口) open, catching them as they come down. Fall (drop, come down, village).

k:字.mnemonic: A child (子) under a roof (宀), sitting at a desk indoors and copying out letters one at a time. Character (letter, word).

k:帰.mnemonic: Back at last: hang up the knife (刂), wipe your forehead (冖) with a towel (巾), and pick up the broom (ヨ) to sweep your own floor. Homecoming (arrive at, lead to, result in).
k:帰.hint: Sweeping your own floor at last.

k:官.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀), in the middle (中) of a maze of corridors and papers, sits the official who stamps them all. Bureaucrat (the government, organ).

k:象.mnemonic: A pig (豕) with a nose so long that it has become an issue (号): it trips over it and trumpets through it. Elephant (pattern after, imitate, image).
k:象.hint: A pig with a very long nose.

k:営.mnemonic: A shop with a long history (史): the owner, a lamp's sparkle (⺌) on the forehead (冖), stays late going through the books room by room. Manage (camp, run a business, perform).
k:営.hint: The owner working late by lamplight.

k:館.mnemonic: Where the bureaucrat (官) goes to eat (食): a grand public hall with its own dining room, far bigger than any house. Building (mansion, large building, palace).

k:六.mnemonic: A lid (亠) with fins (ハ) sticking out underneath: a beetle seen from above, and a beetle has exactly this many legs. Six.

k:未.mnemonic: A tree (木) only six (六) years old, its top branch still short: too young to bear any fruit. Not yet (un-, still, hitherto).
k:未.hint: A sapling too young to fruit.

k:味.mnemonic: The mouth (口) says not yet (未): do not swallow, hold it on the tongue a moment longer and notice it. Flavor (taste).

k:収.mnemonic: A stick (｜) to knock the apples down, and also (又) a hand to catch them: what you bring in at harvest. Income (obtain, reap, pay).
k:収.hint: Knocking down and catching the harvest.

k:園.mnemonic: People go round it many times (回), strolling on the soil (土) in their best garment (衣): the fenced garden where the town walks on Sunday. Park (garden, yard, farm).

k:過.mnemonic: Hood (冂) pulled down over your mouth (口) and eyes, you stride along the path (辶) and go right past your own door. Too far. Overdo (exceed, go beyond, error).
k:過.hint: Walking right past your own door.

k:常.mnemonic: Every morning the same: splash water until it sparkles (⺌), then wipe your forehead (冖) with the towel (巾). An ordinary day. Usual (ordinary, normal, common).
k:常.hint: The same morning wash every day.

k:映.mnemonic: The day (日) sun shines on a big (大) man's bald forehead (冖) and bounces off it like a mirror. Reflect (reflection, projection).
k:映.hint: Sun bouncing off a bald head.
